title: Deep ReLU Networks Can Fail the Best Approximation Property for Continuous Target Functions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We construct a continuous function on $[-1,1]^2$ for which the infimum of the $L^2$-approximation error over the class of ReLU networks with two hidden layers and architecture $(2,2,1,1)$ is not attained. This counterexample shows that deep ReLU networks do not satisfy the best approximation property in general, even for continuous target functions. Our findings contrast with existing results for shallow neural networks, where ReLU is one of the few activation functions that guarantee the existence of global minima in typical regression tasks. The proof is based on the fact that the breaklines for neurons in the second hidden layer can bend, which breaks the symmetry arguments used in the one-hidden-layer case.

translated_title: 深度ReLU网络对连续目标函数可能不满足最佳逼近性质
translated_abstract: 我们在 $[-1,1]^2$ 上构造了一个连续函数，使得在具有两个隐藏层且架构为 $(2,2,1,1)$ 的 ReLU 网络类上，$L^2$ 逼近误差的下确界无法被达到。这一反例表明，深度 ReLU 网络一般不满足最佳逼近性质，即使对于连续目标函数也是如此。我们的发现与浅层神经网络的已有结果形成对比——在浅层网络中，ReLU 是少数能在典型回归任务中保证全局极小值存在的激活函数之一。证明基于这样一个事实：第二隐藏层中神经元的折线（breaklines）可以发生弯曲，这破坏了单隐藏层情形中所使用的对称性论证。
tldr: 本文通过构造连续函数反例证明，深度ReLU网络在一般情形下不满足最佳逼近性质，这与浅层网络中ReLU能保证全局极小值存在的已知结论形成鲜明对比。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a counterexample showing that deep ReLU networks generally fail the best approximation property even for continuous target functions, contrasting with shallow networks where ReLU is among the few activation functions guaranteeing the existence of global minima.
